symptoms: White, talcum-powder-like spots on upper and lower leaf surfaces and petioles
Spots rapidly coalesce covering the entire leaf blade
Leaves turn yellow, brown, and dry to a crisp parchment texture
risk_factors: Dense canopy shading with dry weather and high humidity
prevention: Plant powdery mildew-resistant squash varieties (PMR cultivars)
Space plants widely (1-1.5 meters) in full direct sun
recommended_actions: Apply potassium bicarbonate, neem oil, or sulfur at first appearance of white spots
